patternU01t1●
First taught 2026-09-12. Graded check (mixed, both judgments at once) scored 4/10 = 40%. Same-day repair loop diagnosed the miss as a format artifact, not a concept gap: split retest isolating one judgment at a time scored known/new 2/2 and sound 2/3 = 4/5 (80%, same-day post-key, cannot promote per srs.md). Genuine first-contact gap: the silent-h exception ("an hour") was not taught and was missed — not a repair-loop failure, flagged for U01's next pass. SES-002 (2026-09-13) next-day review, 2 production prompts: prompt 1 missed the article entirely (ERR-004, ART-MISS); prompt 2's article choices were both correct (miss there was the missing "of", ERR-006, not an article error). Later free practice produced 2 more clean article uses, including one fully clean sentence combining the silent-h exception with correct known/new + sound judgment ("In an hour the team is testing a new feature."). Held at tier 1 — one real article miss today, and srs.md's tier-1→2 promotion gate ("two clean recognition passes") is written for vocab's recognition mode; grammar rows here are tested by production instead (session_format.md), and no marker convention exists for what a clean production pass counts as toward that gate. Not promoting past what that gap actually supports; flagged in SES-002 as ambiguous. SES-003 (2026-09-22, reconstructed): production prompt after a 9-day gap dropped the article again on "component" (ERR-008, ART-MISS) — the same slot SES-002 had retested clean inside its own sitting. SES-004 (2026-09-24): article missing again on the same word, then present but with the of-slot filled by a stray "a" ("The button is part a layout"). Three consecutive sittings with a production miss in this row aspect, so demotion applies; already at the tier-1 floor, so the row stays at tier 1 and does not move. Diagnosis taught SES-004: the frame is assembling in fragments — one half per sentence, alternating — which is partial recall of the whole construction, not a wrong rule; retaught as one fixed frame [article] + WORD1 + of + [article] + WORD2. That frame was taught without scoping it to noun-noun and leaked into verb+preposition territory in free production ("works of"), ERR-013.

patternU02t1●
Taught 2026-09-22 (SES-003, U02 page work/visuals/2026-09-22_u02-present-simple.html), measured 2026-09-24 (SES-004). Graded check, unit axis: 6 of 9 attempted = 67%, inside session_format.md 60-70% band. The three misses had ONE cause and pointed in opposite directions — over-marked after "We" (item 4), under-marked on the -o branch (item 5), no finite form built at all (item 7) — which is a decision not being made, not a rule learned wrongly. Repaired in-sitting as an explicit forward procedure: 1 substitute he/she/it/they for the subject, 2 he/she/it takes the ending otherwise base form, 3 the verb is finite, never "to". Retest on three new items 3/3 (same-day, post-key — cannot drive a promotion, srs.md). Free production an hour later produced "The team works" (collective subject, article and -s both right, unprompted) and "I create" (no over-marking). Held at tier 1: the only cold evidence is the 67%.
